tasks.short: Brief the crew on the day's jobs and safety, supervise tree trimming on site, train lower-level employees in climbing and rigging, and record training and briefings.

steps.what: Tree trimmer briefs the crew on the day's jobs and safety at the site
Tree trimmer supervises others engaged in tree trimming work
Tree trimmer trains lower-level employees in climbing and rigging
Tree trimmer records training and safety briefings on paper forms

tasks.design: Safety briefings and training sessions are recorded on a short form in the crew's field app ({OPS_SYSTEM}) with the crew list filled from the day's job, and crew members tick attendance on the phone, so paper forms are not filled and filed. Briefing, supervising and training stay with the tree trimmer.
tasks.previous_blocker: Briefings and training were recorded on paper forms.
tasks.enabler_now: Field apps hold short forms with crew lists from the job.
tasks.human_edge: Seeing that a new climber is not ready for a big tree.

reach.learn: Whether briefings are recorded every day.

evidence.claim: Field apps can hold short forms such as safety briefings with attendance.
Records that show who worked where can monitor workers and need works council consent.

assumptions: Boundary: from the day's jobs to training recorded; hiring is outside.
Input contract: crew on the field app; fallback is paper.
Supervision and training do not change.
Crew members tick attendance in about the time signing paper took.

incremental.description: Tree trimmer fills forms later at sites without signal.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: few recorded sessions; high: daily briefings on many sites.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Inspect trees for diseases and pests, note findings in a notebook, and type them into the tree register at the office.

steps.what: Tree trimmer inspects trees to determine if they have diseases or pest problems
Tree trimmer notes diseases and pests found in a notebook
Tree trimmer types the findings into the tree register at the office

tasks.design: The tree trimmer records findings on the tree's record in a tree inventory app on a tablet ({OTHER}), picking the tree on the map and choosing disease or pest and severity from lists, so notes are not written in a notebook. The record syncs to the tree register, so nothing is typed at the office. Inspecting trees stays with the tree trimmer.
tasks.previous_blocker: Findings were written in a notebook and typed in at the office.
tasks.enabler_now: Tree inventory apps record findings per tree on the map.
tasks.still_hard: Unusual symptoms need free text and photos.
tasks.human_edge: Spotting fungus at the base that means the tree may fail.

reach.learn: Whether findings arrive the same day.

evidence.claim: ArcGIS Tree Management keeps tree condition data and offers a public viewer of the condition of public trees.

assumptions: Boundary: from the inspection round to the register updated; treatment is outside.
Input contract: trees in the register with locations; fallback is the notebook.
research_questions: Do findings reach the register sooner?

incremental.description: Tree trimmer adds trees missing from the register.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: many trees missing from the register; high: a complete register.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Talk with residents about their trees on site, answer calls about pruning dates and ownership, draft e-mail replies with tree-care advice, and send them.

steps.what: Tree trimmer provides information to the public on site about tree care
Tree trimmer answers phone calls about when trees will be pruned and whose tree it is
Tree trimmer writes e-mail replies with advice on tree care

loop.input: The resident's question, the tree's record and the vetted tree-care texts.
loop.output: A draft reply that quotes the vetted texts.
loop.check: Every advice sentence must cite a vetted text paragraph or it is dropped; questions about dangerous trees are not drafted; the tree trimmer edits and approves every reply.
loop.stop: One draft per question; if no sentence passes, the tree trimmer writes the reply.
loop.why_not_simpler: Residents describe their trees in their own words; a fixed list of answers does not match them.

steps.what: Tree trimmer sends the reply to the resident

tasks.design: A public tree map ({OTHER}) shows each public tree's owner, condition and planned pruning date, with a request form; residents who file a request get progress updates, so fewer calls reach the crew. For e-mailed care questions, a bounded step drafts replies only from vetted tree-care texts; questions about dangerous trees go straight to the tree trimmer, who approves every reply before it is sent. Talking with residents on site stays with the tree trimmer.
tasks.previous_blocker: Status and ownership questions came by phone, and care advice was written from scratch.
tasks.enabler_now: Public tree maps show status; language models draft replies that cite vetted texts.
tasks.still_hard: Residents with a dangerous tree still call.
tasks.human_edge: Explaining to an upset resident why their tree must come down.
tasks.altitude: The tree trimmer approves replies instead of writing each one.

reach.learn: Whether they find answers on the map.

evidence.claim: Ezytreev takes resident enquiries through a map portal, routes them to a tree officer's app and sends standard letters and emails with progress updates.
ArcGIS Tree Management offers a public viewer of tree condition, a programme website and a request form.
A resident-facing chatbot must say it is an AI system; here a person approves each reply.

assumptions: Boundary: from the resident question to the reply sent; tree work is outside.
Input contract: tree register current and vetted texts kept; fallback is phone and own replies.
Residents look up the map in less time than a call; a little resident time is priced.
The tree trimmer approves every reply.
research_questions: Do calls about pruning dates fall?

incremental.description: Tree trimmer suggests updates to the vetted texts.
Residents look up trees on the map and file requests.

approvals.approved_version: The reply as edited and approved by the tree trimmer in s3.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: mostly on-site questions; high: many calls and e-mails about status and care.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The tree trimmer keeps supervising crews, inspecting trees and talking with residents; paper forms, notebook findings, status calls and replies from scratch shrink.
role.ambitious_version: A tree trimmer with more time in the trees.
